recipes.label: Establish the Order of the Guiding Palm
recipes.startdescription: The Order of the Guiding Palm is a cult devoted to deciphering and following the mystic movements of the 'Invisible Hand', viewing the ebb and flow of global economy as divine omens.

recipes.label: A Sacrifice of Wealth

slots.label: My Wealth
slots.description: I must give of myself to honour the power we will serve.

recipes.startdescription: The God we will serve requires money. I must give of myself.

recipes.label: Recruit an Acquaintance, by invoking Secrets
recipes.description: In invoking Secret Histories, one commits to the pursuit of obscured truths and reframed perspectives, unearthing life's mysteries.

recipes.label: Promote a Believer by invoking Secrets
recipes.startdescription: My follower will kneel as a novice, and rise as an initiate. I will administer the necessary oaths myself.
recipes.description: 'My knowledge is my armor. Through understanding, I unveil the obscured. There is no mystery but the yet unrevealed. In the whispers of Secret Histories, we find our truth. I dedicate myself to the service of the hidden.'

recipes.label: Attempt to Exalt a Disciple to a Veilkeeper
recipes.startdescription: Only a rare few - those most suited to service in our mysteries - may achieve this rank.
recipes.description: 'This was my past, but now I've evolved. These are my teachings, which I transcend. Here is my belief, but it is not my limit. Here is my identity, which is merely a riddle. Here is the Archive, where we illuminate the shadows. Here I sought, and here I have found.'

recipes.label: Recruit an Acquaintance, by invoking Hand
recipes.description: Embodying the Order of the Guiding Palm, one pledges to balance harmony and hidden wisdom in service of the greater good.

recipes.label: Promote a Believer by invoking Hand
recipes.startdescription: My follower will kneel as a novice, and rise as an initiate. I will administer the necessary oaths myself.
recipes.description: 'My wisdom is my guidance. Through harmony, I ascend to enlightenment. There is no confusion but in ignorance. In the embrace of the Guiding Palm, we find our path. I pledge myself to the service of the balanced.'

recipes.label: Attempt to Exalt a Disciple to a Capitalist
recipes.startdescription: Only a rare few - those most suited to service in our mysteries - may achieve this rank.
recipes.description: 'This was my journey, but now I am transformed. These are my teachings, which I transcend. Here are my hands, but they reach beyond me. Here is my title, but it is only a veil. Here is the Palm, where we guide the lost. Here I sought, and here I found.'
